message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"e075","prompts":["我手上有个 staff scheduling 的问题，每个员工每天最多排 8 小时，而且周末必须至少有 3 个人在岗，能不能帮我用 PySCIPOpt 建模求一个最小人力成本的排班方案？","我们在做 warehouse 的 bin packing，箱子有不同尺寸，托盘容量有限，帮我写个脚本用 optimization 的方式算出最少的托盘数？","有一批 delivery orders，每单有时间窗要求，我想解一个 VRP 的 routing 问题，用 SCIP 可以吗？给我写个 demo 跑一下？","公司预算有限，要在 N 个候选项目里做 selection，每个项目有 cost 和 expected ROI，还有 dependency 约束，帮我用 integer programming 挑出收益最大的一组？","生产线上有几台 machine，每个 job 有 processing time 和 due date，晚交货要付 penalty，帮我 model 一个 scheduling 问题让总 tardiness 最小？"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e076","prompts":["I recorded a webinar but the first minute or two is just the title slide with no audio—can you find where the actual talking starts so I can trim the dead air?","My screen recording has some setup time at the beginning where I was getting my mic ready; help me detect how much leading silence there is before my voice kicks in.","Before I upload this lecture video, I want to cut the pre-roll where nothing is happening. Can you analyze the beginning and tell me the timestamp where sound first appears?","The podcast episodes I publish always seem to have awkward dead air before the intro. Can you check this file and report the length of the silent segment at the very start?","I have a stack of meeting recordings and I suspect several begin with long quiet stretches while people join. Can you identify the low-energy region at the head of each one?"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e079","prompts":[],"rubric":[],"note":"placeholder removed"},{"item_id":"e077","prompts":["我们的 Java 项目打包的时候总是把测试也跑一遍，很浪费时间，能不能告诉我在什么 phase 执行什么 goal 才能跳过测试直接构建？","我想在构建的时候根据环境自动启用不同的配置，比如 dev 和 prod 用不同的依赖版本，Maven 的 profile 应该怎么写？","公司要求发布的 jar 里必须包含源码和 javadoc，我在 pom 里应该绑定哪些插件到哪个 lifecycle 阶段？","跑 mvn install 和 mvn deploy 到底有什么区别？我总是搞不清楚它们各自会执行到哪个构建阶段？","我想在 compile 之后自动执行一个自定义脚本，比如生成一些代码文件，这个应该挂到 Maven 生命周期的哪个环节？"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e078","prompts":["GitHub 的 notification 太多了，帮我用工具把那些老的 PR 通知 dismiss 掉，别让 inbox 一直有未读。","那些已经 merge 掉的 issue 通知我不想再看了，能不能批量 mark as read？","我想把上周的 CI 失败通知都标成 done，反正问题已经修了，帮我处理一下？","我 inbox 里堆了一堆 release 相关的通知，帮我清理一下，把这些 dismiss 了。","有些 review 请求我早就回复过了但通知还挂着，帮我把它标记为已读吧。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e079","prompts":["I'm writing a branching narrative for an RPG and the script is getting messy—can you parse my dialogue file into a proper graph so I can see all the choice paths?","I have a flowchart of a chatbot conversation in a text format; help me turn it into a structure I can validate for unreachable nodes and dead ends.","Before handing my interactive fiction script to the engine, I want to serialize the branching dialogue into JSON. Can you build that from my scene descriptions?","Can you take this interview transcript with labeled answer options and produce a visual diagram of how the conversation branches depending on responses?","My game has dialogue that loops back on itself in places, and I'm worried about infinite cycles. Can you model it as a graph and check whether the structure is valid?"],"rubric":[]}]}
